title: Reproduction and Adolescence
summary: How plants and animals make new life, from potato eyes and bee-pollinated flowers to frogs and hens, and the changes of adolescence, when our own bodies grow up.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Living things change through life cycles and reproduction, and understanding the changes of adolescence helps us care for ourselves and respect others.

factual: What is the difference between sexual and asexual reproduction?
What are the parts of a flower?
conceptual: Why do plants have so many ways of spreading their seeds?
How do hormones bring about the changes of adolescence?
debatable: Should farmers rely on crops that are all identical copies?
How can schools best support students through adolescence?
